summary: Helmerich & Payne, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share on common stock, payable September 1, 2026, to holders of record August 18, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program (beyond ordinary dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is indicated. The filing is merely a standard current report of an ordinary dividend action.
